2.15.1 Subreport.Name
The Subreport.Name attribute specifies a unique identifier for a Subreport definition. This attribute
MUST be specified. The value of this attribute MUST be a case-sensitive CLS-compliant identifier
[UTR15] that is unique for all report items within a Report.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.Name attribute.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
